title: Centered moving-target compensation drops to manual or zero
symptom: While the selected target remains centered and continues moving relative to the reticle, delivered right-stick compensation drops to zero until position error accumulates and correction resumes.

facts.claim: In the target range, after AI reaches a dummy's chest, left-stick strafing produces delayed, pulse-like compensation.
The known-bad fixture enters Track with both target-error axes inside 1 px, non-zero AI motion proposals on both axes, and zero physical right-stick input; final output is zero on both axes.
When the AI proposal is zero, the same fixture returns both centered axes to physical manual input.

inferences.claim: Releasing axis authority solely because position error enters the center threshold can create a release-drift-reacquire compensation pulse during continuous tracking.

unknowns.question: How much visible pulse reduction the candidate produces in the live BOT-room game response.

trigger_assertions: Track authority is established on both axes before the center crossing.
Both center errors are 0.25 px and both shaped AI proposals are materially non-zero.
Physical right-stick input is zero during the moving-target sample.

covariates.freshness: fresh authoritative samples at a fixed 5 ms interval
covariates.target_generation: constant selector generation 61 and target id 1001
covariates.right_stick_manual: zero on the incident sample; 0.12/-0.14 only in the idle counterfactual
covariates.left_stick_manual: not_applicable: the local authority API receives the resulting non-zero shaped motion proposal rather than physical left-stick state
covariates.recoil_firing: not_applicable: the state-machine unit surface is upstream of recoil and carries no firing input
covariates.logging_mode: CTest JUnit with measured trigger, output, retained-axis, and counterfactual fields

counterfactuals.change: Set both shaped AI proposals to zero while keeping the target centered and provide small physical manual input.
counterfactuals.expected: Both axes switch to manual passthrough and reproduce the physical manual values.
